introHtml: Cuff apparel accessories, like fleece mittens with extended cuffs, provide extra warmth and protection for outdoor workers and event attendees. A ribbed or elasticized cuff keeps gloves secure, preventing snow or debris from entering. Customize with your logo for a practical giveaway that gets used all winter. Perfect for safety managers equipping crews or marketers promoting winter events.
